title: Rethinking Latency Denial-of-Service: Attacking the LLM Serving Framework, Not the Model
abstract: arXiv:2602.07878v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM inference is inherently expensive, even a modest slowdown can translate into substantial operating costs and severe availability risks. Recently, a growing body of research known as latency attacks focuses on crafting inputs to trigger worst-case output lengths. However, we report a contrary finding that these algorithmic-level latency attacks are largely ineffective against modern LLM serving systems. We reveal that system-level optimization such as continuous batching provides a logical isolation to mitigate contagious latency impact on co-located users. Thus, in this paper, we shift our focus from the algorithm to the system layer, and introduce a new Fill and Squeeze attack strategy targeting the state transition of the scheduler. ``Fill'' first exhausts the global KV cache to induce Head-of-Line blocking, while ``Squeeze'' forces the system into repetitive preemption. translated_title: 重新思考延迟拒绝服务攻击：攻击LLM服务框架而非模型本身
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理本身成本高昂，即使是轻微的速度下降也可能转化为巨大的运营成本和严重的可用性风险。近年来，一系列被称为“延迟攻击”的研究专注于构造输入以触发最坏情况的输出长度。然而，我们报告了一个相反的发现：这些算法层面的延迟攻击对现代LLM服务系统基本无效。我们揭示了诸如连续批处理等系统级优化提供了逻辑隔离，能够缓解延迟对同宿用户的传染性影响。因此，本文将关注点从算法层转移到系统层，提出了一种针对调度器状态转换的新型“填充与挤压”攻击策略。“填充”阶段首先耗尽全局KV缓存以引发队头阻塞，而“挤压”阶段则迫使系统进入重复的抢占状态。通过使用不同的攻击手段操纵输出长度
tldr: 该论文发现算法级延迟攻击对采用连续批处理的现代LLM服务系统无效，并提出一种针对调度器状态转换的新型系统层“填充与挤压”攻击策略，通过耗尽全局KV缓存引发队头阻塞并迫使系统重复抢占，从而实现延迟拒绝服务攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that algorithmic-level latency attacks are largely ineffective against modern LLM serving systems due to continuous batching, and proposes a novel system-level "Fill and Squeeze" attack targeting scheduler state transitions, which exhausts the global KV cache to induce Head-of-Line blocking and forces repetitive preemption to achieve latency denial-of-service.
